b: Thrill Jockey will release Colder, Milder in February
Brokeback, the band led by Tortoise's Douglas McCombs, have announced their first album in over a decade.

Spanning eight tracks, Colder, Milder sees the quartet refine their post-surf rock sound, prioritising simplicity and restraint, according to a press release. It's led by the title track, which you can listen to below.

In a statement about the lead cut, McCombs said: "This song was built around the three-note figure in the verses, simple. The guitar harmonies that start the song and recur halfway through were imagined as Everly Brothers vocal harmonies, but didn’t really end up sounding like that."
Thrill Jockey will release Colder, Milder on 26 February 2027.
